architecturalAssertions.assertion: Three levels with flat roofs. Level-dependent E/C outlines; two historic schools joined through the central gym.

Mostly blind sculptural ends, two slender rectangular towers at the Cabral-facing end. Yellow brick body with red brick plinth and door frame. Curved convex/concave entrance walls and ladder glazing above the doors.
Five classroom bays with windows over three tiers; subdivided upper panes. Corners include curved masonry.
Seven varied bays; projecting gym and stair volumes, recessed toilet windows and upper corridor glazing. Stepped setbacks need separate storey geometry.
Expressive brick street ends and enclosed court-facing frontage; Amsterdam School interiors. Municipal monument 200681, build period 1924.
